data.title: 庄方宜 · 把周末行程画给你看
data.description: 家中书桌前，庄方宜穿青瓷交领与墨蓝长裙，俯身在空白便笺上画简洁的路线草图。她停下笔把纸转向你，另一只手压住纸角，眼里有一起出门的期待。画面不要求可读文字。
data.action: 将画好的路线草图转向镜头，抬头与你商量
data.mood: 安静投入的亲近与期待
data.promptProse: Zhuang Fangyi leans over the home desk to draw the simple route sketch, then turns the note toward the viewer while holding its corner flat. Her ivory cross-collar blouse with celadon facings and ink-blue skirt remain in the eye-level medium view. The near paper edge overlaps the desktop. Behind her shoulder, a short row of books sits against the back of a narrow shelf, and the side-window frame marks where the desk meets the wall. Afternoon light from that window reveals the pencil paths and paper grain. Her wrist casts a narrow shadow, with softer shade beneath the shelf keeping the room from becoming a flat backdrop.
